blocks.explanation: Longevity science mapped onto the framework. Aging is defined not as the passage of chronological time but as the gradual topological deformation and entropic decay of the biological Markov blanket: since the Perpetuation of Life requires holding a non-equilibrium steady state, aging is the accumulation of systemic friction that eventually forces the probability current to zero. Part 1 gives the geometry of aging — epigenetic drift as metric corruption, where a youthful high-fidelity metric tensor with a deep potential well degrades into a distorted, shallower, higher-entropy one; and cellular senescence as thermodynamic dissipation, where cells that neither divide nor cleanly delete themselves persist as local heat-sinks radiating inflammatory friction. Part 2 reads anti-aging interventions as damping operators that minimize the rate of entropy production: senolytics as active topological pruning of corrupted coordinate space, and metabolic optimization along the AMPK/mTOR axis as autophagic removal of structural noise. Part 3 separates age reversal as something stronger — reprogramming with Yamanaka factors read as a forced non-linear phase transition dragging the cell state back toward the embryonic coordinate origin — and states its cost honestly through Maxwell's demon: local negative entropy is bought with massive exogenous information and energy pumped in from outside.
